title: A Horizon for the Provision
author: Jonah Brightwater
blurb: Sebastian Thornbury, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
